name: Ancient Town
title: Ancient Town
summary: A larger Empyrean ruin site with a stone tower, bunkers (one with the Dungeon of Tatters portal), a meeting hall with a portal to High Mountain Valley, and an Empyrean platform with pillars and the Heartland portal (acpedia). In the kit, on flat ground at z 50, a moss-green Empyrean ruin tower stands in a ring of 11 broken stone pillars and 8 ancient columns. Around it are a three-storey brick meeting hall, a low bunker, a pillared platform carrying the Heartland portal swirl, and the Life Stone on a fabric platform.
